result.title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
result.summary: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CoworkEnv，一个能力引导的框架，用工作流需求合成可执行的长时程「AI 同事」训练环境，并借此生成演示与交互 rollout，分别用于 SFT 和 RL，训练紧凑的 PocketWorker 模型，在 Claw-Eval 与 ClawMark 上报告多轮任务提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文不研究视觉 latent 推理，但其多轮轨迹 rollout 训练、以及变动奖励处理与贡献分配（credit assignment）的 RL 配置对比，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练与信用分配监督设计提供可核查的方法线索。
